thread_title: S. flava var. rubricorpora liberty co, clone T
breadcrumb: S. flava var. rubricorpora liberty co, clone T

posts.body_html: One of the more classic looking rubricorporas, S. flava var. rubricorpora clone T is a standard by which you can compare other rubricorporas to! They look their best right when the traps open! Under good conditions, you'll get a solid red body and yellow top!
posts.body_text: One of the more classic looking rubricorporas, S. flava var. rubricorpora clone T is a standard by which you can compare other rubricorporas to!  They look their best right when the traps open!  Under good conditions, you'll get a solid red body and yellow top!

posts.body_html: Really like this clone with its classic spout. I note the 'bleeding' in the hood. Tell me Mike, does the red fully infuse throughout the plant as the season advances?

posts.body_html: Kiwiearl, as you probably have experienced, the traps of S. flava var. rubricorpora in general  have the most striking/contrasting yellow lid/dark red body for about the first 2 weeks after it opens.  After that, the bright yellow lid turns dark red and eventually, some people would call it S. flava var. atropurpurea, since the entire trap can become solid red.

It's been a long time since I updated this thread, and holy Ka-DAyang! What exactly does that mean, we may never know, but what I do know is WHA-BAM! this clone is good looking! Okay, I think I'm good on the hyperboles. Makes me wonder why it hasn't been bred with pretty much at all...and a lot of you out there have this clone. I certainly neglected breeding with it until this year.

Performing again this year, been waiting all winter long for this! Traps are pretty big this time around, pics taken 4/19/20:






Surprisingly, as many of these rubricorporas were emerging, the traps weren't very red, even right when the "balloon popped" open aka the trap popped open. But a day or two later, the red started getting more intense. In previous years, the same clone had red traps even before the pitchers opened:
